About Pralux

We're a small crew that plans big India trips.

Pralux Holidays builds tailor-made domestic holidays — from Meghalaya's cloud forests to Kashmir's houseboats and Goa's back-lane cafés. No fixed packages sold off a shelf: every plan starts with a conversation, not a catalogue.

We handle stays, local transport, permits where needed, and the small details that turn a trip into something you actually remember.

The Route

Where we take people.

A working list — not everything we do, just where most conversations start. All over India, all year round.

N.01

Meghalaya

Living root bridges, Dawki's glass rivers, Nohkalikai falls and cloud-wrapped villages.

Northeast · Best Nov–Mar
N.02

Kashmir

Houseboat mornings, Mughal gardens, Sonmarg meadows and Gulmarg's winter slopes.

North · Best Apr–Oct
N.03

Rajasthan

Palace stays in Udaipur, dunes in Jaisalmer, the blue city of Jodhpur and Ranthambhore.

North · Best Oct–Feb
N.04

Goa

Quiet beaches, Portuguese-era Fontainhas, spice farms and the best seafood in the country.

West · Best Nov–Feb
N.05

Kerala

Backwater cruises in Alleppey, Munnar's tea gardens, Wayanad forests and Kovalam sunsets.

South · Best Sep–Mar
N.06

Himachal Pradesh

Manali's snowfields, Spiti Valley's ancient monasteries, Kasol pine trails, Dharamshala calm.

North · Best Apr–Jun, Sep–Oct

How It Works

Four steps to your trip.

1

Tell us what you want

WhatsApp, call, or fill the form. Tell us where, when, who's coming, and roughly what you want to spend.

2

We draft your itinerary

Within 24 hours we send a custom day-by-day plan with stay options, costs, and alternatives.

3

You refine it

Change anything. Swap stays, adjust pace, add or remove days — until it's exactly right for you.

4

We handle everything

We book, confirm, and stay available on WhatsApp throughout your entire trip.
